actions.name: Use
actions.area: creatures within a 30-ft.-radius spread centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates the ground-shaking shockwave of a behemoth
description.value: The caster emulates the ground-shaking shockwave of a behemoth. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage, inflicted with the Weighted status effect, and are pushed back 5 feet per 10 damage sustained. A successful Reflex save reduces the damage by half, negates the status effect, and stops being pushed back. Learned From Behemoth Family, Earth Elemental Family, Forgiven Apathy, Kaiser Dragon, Long Arm, and Golem Family
